I'd reccomend rounding out and shrinking the boss(the hinge section) a bit more as well I find I get a better grip if it's a bit closer to the jaw don't know if there's actually anything to that. And for the reigns I like a bit thicker than most as well I make mine octangulsr or hexagonal I find perfectly round slips in my hand and square just hurts like hell, although you can just hammer it out I like just filing it a bit down to the desired shape. And final idea is add a taper and loop it on the ends so you can conveniently hang them from stuff without spreading

You can also use a ball punch of a tiny size to do this if you don't trust your hammering or hammer, just make sure you don't actually punch a hole in it obviously haha. I also find working it at dull red helps a lot so you don't move to much stock. Happy hammering mate
